featured_reviews.review_text: The therapist Chan was really good however the place needed some upkeep. The sheet was torn, AC could only be on or off, temp couldn't be regulated. Hence when the ac was turned off, could hear all the voices from outside. The shower area was very small. It wasn't cleaned between massages which was a little disgusting. Really hoped for a better experience
